title: Dechlorination of fly ash through co-leaching with organic waste: effect of inoculum
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,26292-26298
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09937D, Paper

Xiaona Wang, Dezhi Zou, Chuanfu Wu, Yueming Gao, Jianguo Liu, Qunhui Wang
This study presents a co-leaching method using organic waste to enhance dechlorination of incineration fly ash and increase its mixture amount for cement kiln co-disposal.
